Tracker_Addons_v0.1.0.description:
New concept!

With Tracker Addons installed, worlds can now define functions that UT will load

current commands
* next progression (finally got rid of it 😈 )
* glp as an alias for get_logical_path
* get_depth will show the "shallowest" locations in logic
* get_regions lists known regions (optional filter)
* nearest_locations is get_depth but you decide where the start region is (requires worlds to be built to support 2 way entrances to be useful)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/compare/Tracker_v0.2.34...Tracker_Addons_v0.1.0
